name: @plane/api-types
description: TypeScript types generated from the API's OpenAPI schemas

scripts.generate: openapi-typescript ../../apps/api/openapi/internal.yaml -o src/generated/internal.ts && openapi-typescript ../../apps/api/openapi/admin.yaml -o src/generated/admin.ts && openapi-typescript ../../apps/api/openapi/v1.yaml -o src/generated/v1.ts
